first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Weapon A
entities.identification: The slender, dark long gun raised from the bottom edge during the weapon switch and subsequently held facing forward, with light-colored mottling on its surface.

entities.name: Weapon B
entities.identification: The dark short gun held by Person A at the beginning, located in the lower-right foreground.

entities.name: muddy shell-cratered ground
entities.identification: The dark, undulating muddy ground extending from the foreground to the midground, interspersed with gravel, fragments, and depressions.

entities.name: cluster of ruined walls and rubble
entities.identification: The damaged brick-and-stone walls near the flagpole and farther away, with jagged top edges and rectangular openings locally preserved.

entities.name: cluster of dead trees
entities.identification: The leafless tree trunks, short broken branches, tree stumps, and fallen foreground trees in the scene.

entities.name: smoke-cloud-filled sky
entities.identification: The large expanse of gray, cloud-filled sky in the upper portion, brighter and warm-colored on the right in the latter part.

entities.name: orange point of fire
entities.identification: The brief bright flame at the bottom edge of Vehicle A and the orange-yellow areas of flame near the ruins and dead trees in the latter part.

entities.name: damaged vertical flag
entities.identification: The tall, slender flagpole and flag fabric with alternating dark and light stripes; the flag fabric hangs folded and changes shape over the continuous footage.

entities.name: Vehicle A
entities.identification: The large, mud-covered tracked armored vehicle occupying the left side at the beginning, with a frame on top and a light-colored cross, circular marking, and lettering on its side.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: The first-person weapon holder, identified by the close-up gloved hands, wrists, and cuffs, holding Weapon B first and then switching to Weapon A.

entities.name: ruins smoke cloud
entities.identification: The low-altitude, thin gray-brown smoke near Vehicle A and around the walls, as well as the darker smoke cloud behind the wall in the latter part.

At frame 0, the muddy shell-cratered ground is dark gray-brown, uneven and undulating, and interspersed with gray gravel and chunks; irregular mounds of earth, depressions, and scattered, relatively large slab-like fragments are visible.
At frame 0, the cluster of ruined walls and rubble consists of damaged gray-black brick-and-stone walls with incomplete outlines and rectangular openings locally preserved.

At frame 0, the cluster of ruined walls and rubble consists of damaged gray-black brick-and-stone walls with rectangular openings locally preserved; the tops of the walls are jagged, the side edges are incomplete, and a brighter background shows through the openings.
At frame 0, the smoke-cloud-filled sky is covered by a large expanse of gray to gray-white clouds and mist and is dim overall.
At frame 0, a large expanse of the smoke-cloud-filled sky is gray to gray-white and dim overall; the clouds and mist form softly bounded layers of light and dark that transition into low-lying haze.

At frame 0, the damaged vertical flag has a tall, slender flagpole and long flag fabric with alternating dark and light stripes; the flag fabric hangs folded, the stripes curve along diagonal folds, and the bottom edge has an uneven, winding outline.

At frame 0, Vehicle A is a large, dark gray tracked armored vehicle, most of its body covered in mud, with part of the outline of its rhomboid track, a short side-mounted gun, and a top frame visible.

At frame 0, Vehicle A is a large, dark gray tracked armored vehicle, most of its body covered in mud, with part of the outline of its rhomboid track, a short side-mounted gun, and a top frame visible; the mud clumps on the side are coarse and thick, with a light-colored cross-shaped pattern, a circular marking, and the lettering “F14,” and the top frame is formed by multiple intersecting rods.
At frame 0, Person A's exposed hand wears a dark glove.

At frame 0, Person A's gun-holding hand wears a dark glove; the back of the hand has a curved outline and soft variations in light and shade, the wrist joins a gray-green cuff, and the hand and wrist are in the foreground.
At frame 0, the ruins smoke cloud appears as a large expanse of thin gray-brown smoke covering the near-midground.

At frame 0, the ruins smoke cloud is a large expanse of thin gray-brown smoke covering the near-midground; the smoke layer is translucent and uneven in lightness, and parts of the outlines of Vehicle A and the cluster of ruined walls and rubble are visible through it.
At frame 10, the orange point of fire appears as bright yellow-white and orange flames.

At frame 119, Weapon A is a slender, elongated dark gray-black long gun with a long barrel and a relatively thick gun body; extensive light-colored mottling is visible on the surface, a raised sight structure is present above the gun body, and some metal edges reflect light.
At frame 119, the muddy shell-cratered ground is dark black-brown, muddy and undulating, and mixed with gray gravel; the surface of the depression on the right is wet and bright.

At frame 119, the muddy shell-cratered ground is dark black-brown, undulating, and mixed with gray gravel; the surface has irregular depressions, earthen ridges, small fragments, and trench-like low areas, and the depression on the right reflects patches of bright light.
At frame 119, the cluster of ruined walls and rubble consists of gray-black brick-and-stone wall remnants, with broken, uneven tops and rectangular openings locally preserved.

At frame 119, the cluster of ruined walls and rubble consists of gray-black brick-and-stone wall remnants, with jagged, broken tops and rectangular openings locally preserved; rough masonry blocks, uneven gaps, and relatively flat remnants of the surface layer are visible on the walls, and a bright background shows through the openings.
At frame 119, the cluster of dead trees consists mainly of dark leafless trunks and tree stumps, some of which are slender, with an additional thicker fallen trunk in the foreground.

At frame 119, the cluster of dead trees consists of dark leafless trunks, tree stumps, and a thicker fallen tree in the foreground; the trunks vary in thickness, some have short broken branches and snapped pointed ends, and slender distant trees overlap in layers in the mist.

At frame 119, the smoke-cloud-filled sky is predominantly gray-white, darker on the left and bright with a pale warm yellow tint on the right; the cloud layers form soft gradations of light and dark, diffuse light shows through the bright area on the right, and it transitions into pale mist toward the distant horizon.

At frame 119, the damaged vertical flag has a visible slender flagpole and a portion of flag fabric with alternating dark and light stripes that hangs folded, with the upper part of the flag fabric outside the frame; the stripes can be seen bending along the folds, and the outline of the bottom edge is uneven.
